formation.note: No source fetched states a formation date for the Milagro Collaboration; the official page is an archived copy that lists no dates.

intervals.label: collaboration active
intervals.note: Lower bound: the date the Milagro pond began operating, not a sourced formation date; the end is the end of Milagro operations (2008).
intervals.quote: The construction of the Milagro pond was completed in early 1999, and operations began in mid 1999.

intervals.label: data taking ended
intervals.note: Milagro "operated from 2000 to 2008"; analysis papers continued to appear afterwards.

website.note: The live Los Alamos page no longer exists; the URL is the Internet Archive capture of www.lanl.gov/milagro/.

name: Milagro Collaboration
notes: Membership counts are left null: no source fetched states them. The archived official page has a "People and institutions that designed and built Milagro" section that was not captured as text.

summary.plain: The scientists who built and operated the Milagro water-Cherenkov gamma-ray observatory in New Mexico.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the Milagro water-Cherenkov TeV gamma-ray and cosmic-ray observatory at Fenton Hill, New Mexico, until 2008; successor effort HAWC reused its photomultipliers.
